subject: Re: EIM kickoff: energy-inspired models as a platform library
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing plan. Fumiko and Ondrej carry the modeling work (reproduction plus API design), full time through March.

For adoption we need more than docs - teams won't trust a probabilistic-modeling library without comparable numbers. So I'm scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch - Nikhil at 50% on the backend, Tereza at 50% on the submission/scoring flow - so every EIM variant gets a ranked, reproducible score the whole org can browse. Rough shape: result submission API, a scoring worker that re-runs configs, and a ranked web view. Four to five weeks of build, MVP by mid-March.

Compute is light: the small_problems targets run on CPU, MNIST variants need a handful of Titan A100 slots, nothing reserved.

One dependency: Corpus ingestion for the static MNIST splits so scoring runs are hermetic. Filing that request today.

Santiago
